verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the button beside the commit message field can suggest messages using AI, generated by sending the staged differences to OpenAI. The homepage also advertises commit suggestions as an opt-in feature. That matches the story of AI commit messages based on staged changes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality, and detail on model choice or configuration (e.g. alternative providers or a custom API key).
